# ForcePlace

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** ForcePlace

## What it does

Places a block on blocks where you normally would open a gui by sneaking

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/ForcePlace.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
